name: Zenbit Invitation Builder
author: goran007

sections.description:
Zenbit Invitation Builder is a WordPress plugin for creating invitation forms and generating personalized digital invitation images.

Version 1.0.0 includes the complete core workflow with one ready-to-use template. You can build a template, map form fields onto the invitation design, preview the generated result, publish the form with a shortcode, and send invitation emails based on submitted form data.

The plugin is designed for sites that need a focused invitation workflow inside WordPress without a large setup process.

What It Does

Zenbit Invitation Builder gives you a clear invitation workflow inside WordPress:

  • Create and manage invitation templates
  • Map form fields onto a personalized invitation image
  • Preview the generated invitation in the admin
  • Publish a frontend invitation form with a shortcode
  • Generate and email a personalized invitation from submitted form data

Who It Is For

Zenbit Invitation Builder is suitable for:

  • site owners who want to manage invitation workflows directly in WordPress
  • event businesses that need a practical digital invitation starting point
  • projects that want one clear invitation flow without extra complexity

Key Features

  • Invitation template editor inside WordPress
  • Visual field mapping for personalized invitation output
  • Admin preview of generated invitation images
  • Separate frontend form editor for submission fields and form settings
  • Shortcode-based form publishing
  • Personalized invitation image generation from submitted form data
  • Built-in email template settings for sending invitations

Free Version Scope

The free version includes:

  • one fully functional template
  • template editing, preview, and submission flow
  • frontend form publishing with shortcode output
  • invitation image generation from form submissions
  • built-in email layout for sending invitations
  • footer branding in generated invitation output

An optional Pro upgrade is available for sites that need additional templates and more advanced email or template workflows.

Basic Usage

  1. Create your invitation template in the WordPress admin.
  2. Configure the image layout and map the fields you want to personalize.
  3. Save and preview the generated invitation.
  4. Configure the frontend form and email settings.
  5. Publish the template post.

  6. Add the shortcode to a page using the template ID:

    [zenbinv_form template=”123″]

  7. Open the page on the frontend, submit the form, and review the generated invitation email flow.

Upgrade to Pro

Pro is available as an optional upgrade for sites that need a broader workflow. It adds:

  • additional templates
  • automatic removal of free footer branding
  • advanced email options such as Reply-To, CC, and BCC
  • advanced email body editing with placeholders

The free plugin remains fully usable on its own for a focused single-template setup.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate Zenbit Invitation Builder.
  3. Open the Invite Templates menu in the WordPress admin.
  4. Create or edit your template.
  5. Configure the invitation layout, form fields, and email settings.
  6. Publish the template and place the shortcode on a page.
sections.faq:
What does the free version include?

The free plugin includes the core invitation workflow with one fully functional template. You can build a template, publish the form with a shortcode, generate a personalized invitation image, and send invitation emails from WordPress.

Do I need the Pro addon to use the plugin?

No. The free plugin works on its own and includes the full core workflow for a single-template setup.

What does Pro add?

Pro adds additional templates and more advanced email and template workflow options.

Can I use the plugin without coding?

Yes. The intended workflow is managed through the WordPress admin, with shortcode placement used to display the frontend form.

Does the free version support frontend form submission?

Yes. You can publish the form with the shortcode, accept submissions, generate personalized invitation output, and send invitation emails in the free version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

First public WordPress.org release with the complete core invitation workflow, including one template, frontend form publishing, invitation image generation, and email sending.

0.6.5

Final upload artifact for the WordPress.org submission after the last compliance/version alignment pass.

0.6.4

Admin request handling hardening pass for WordPress.org review: stricter nonce and capability guards in admin save and preview AJAX handlers, POST-based preview-image fetches, and tighter request input validation.

0.6.3

Current review-ready free baseline. The package identity, entry-file alignment, and release metadata now match the shipped WordPress.org build.

0.6.2

Current locked release baseline. Plugin Check cleanup and release packaging alignment are included in this patch release.

0.6.1

  • Current public free baseline
  • One-template invitation workflow
  • Admin preview workflow
  • Frontend form and submission flow
  • Free email template settings
  • Free branded invitation output
